propositions: Network-capable git call sites in gerrit_client.py and workspace.py lack explicit timeout parameters and can block indefinitely on stuck remotes or hung credential helpers.
subprocess.TimeoutExpired exceptions are not caught by existing exception handlers in gerrit_client.py, allowing the raw exception to propagate and potentially leak bot credentials via the fetch URL.
The existing _ref_lock.py module already enforces timeouts structurally through a required timeout parameter on its single git seam and needs no modification.
Two deferred git call sites in _commands/init.py and _commands/fsck_repair.py are blocked by parallel bug 01e8 work and split to task 983f.
A 300-second timeout value matches the cold-fetch profile of gerrit_client and workspace, avoiding both unbounded hangs and breaking legitimate large clone operations.
